'''''Star Wars: Han Solo''''' is a [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Marjorie Liu]] and illustrated by [[Mark Brooks]]. The comic is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], and centers on the character of [[Han Solo]] in his early days with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. The five-issue series began publication in [[June]] [[2016]].
